Q8376.reason: Proportionality (fitting the crime) is a retributivist desert-based principle, whereas the other options are forward-looking consequentialist aims.

Q8379.reason: Resolution 678 authorised 'all necessary means' to restore international peace and security in the area, which is broader than self-defence under Article 51.

Q8385.reason: Under ILC Articles on State Responsibility, an internationally wrongful act is conduct attributable to the State that breaches an international obligation.
